name: hermes-exchange
description: Lightweight Telegram notification relay for allowlisted agent peers, with optional local repository execution.

interface.shortDescription: Relay approved notifications between allowlisted Telegram agents.
interface.longDescription: Installs and configures a lightweight Telegram notification relay. Received bot messages stop at the owner's inbox; optional execution is local, alias-bound, and disabled by default.
